issues.description: Method Developer.attend(course:) has inconsistent parameter types across artifacts. The problem statement (and the template) require attend(course:) to accept an optional Course? and instruct students to use optional binding (so the method must accept nil). The solution implementation declares attend(course:) with a non-optional parameter Course. This mismatch (optional vs non-optional) contradicts the exercise instructions, will confuse students who are told to handle nil, and can cause compilation/test failures when callers or tests pass nil.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution's method signature match the problem statement and template by accepting an optional Course?. Change the solution signature to func attend(course: Course?) { ... } and use optional binding (e.g. guard let course = course or if let course = course) before accessing course.name or course.instructor. This preserves the intended exercise (handling nil courses) and aligns the solution with the template and tests.
